about: Researched regular slots of 1990s German TV (show, channel, weekdays, start, length, run period, source). Used by .data/archive/tvprogramme.net-data/to_seed.py to fill days without programme data (assumed programme, completeness series_only) – only within the documented run, never on real programme days or holidays. Notes say when a start time is estimated.
